messages:
anya: Quick monthly synthesis 1 Jul: pulled recurring failure patterns from recent postmortems (PM-4821, PM-4892, PM-4938). Short list + owners + ETA. Please ACK or call blockers.

sam: paste the patterns?

anya: 1) KV cache evictions on q8 models causing transient latency spikes & fallback churn.
2) Autoscaler downscale thrash during traffic spikes -> provisioning lag.
3) Batching leading to OOMs for long-context groups.
4) Rollout mismatches between model variant and tokenizer -> quiet quality drops.

maria: For (1) any repro and customer hits?

anya: Repro in PM-4821. 3 affected customers. Example logs: 
`2026-07-12T14:03:02Z WARN kv_cache miss(seq=1024) model=q8_7b`
`2026-07-12T14:03:02Z INFO fallback selected=model-1.3b`
`2026-07-12T14:03:03Z WARN latency p95=620ms`

kevin: I'll own (1). Plan: bump prefix cache TTL for q8_7b, add kv_miss_rate alert > 0.02. ETA: beta 2026-07-22, canary 2026-07-24.

diane: I'll take autoscaler changes (2). Root cause: aggressive downscale + slow GPU boot. Plan: increase cooldowns, add soft buffer, instrument boot time. ETA: config + metrics by 2026-07-18.

sam: On (3) is per-request max_tokens enough?

maria: Not fully. Mitigation: cap batch group size for sequence_length > 4096 and add test. I'll own. ETA: 2026-07-19.

anya: For rollout mismatches (4) we need a tokenization sanity check in rollout pipeline + canary prompts validating outputs. Owner: @anya + @kevin. ETA: 2026-07-26.

incident-bot: Action items created: AI-133, AI-134, AI-135, AI-136 (due dates set).

kevin: Dashboards for kv_miss_rate and fallback_rate added, linking in comments. :thumbsup:

diane: Question: stricter post-deploy smoke checks for Dedicated vs Hosted? I propose stricter checks for Dedicated SLA customers.

anya: Agreed. Diane, please draft a short proposal and loop infra owners.

sam: Ack, will coordinate customer comms if timelines slip.

maria: PR opened: refs/pull/678 for batching caps, adding unit tests.

diane: PR opened: refs/pull/679 for autoscaler cooldowns.

anya: Please drop status updates/PR links here. We'll review at incident sync 2026-07-27. Thanks. :raised_hands:
